hmac_audit.file_hmac: Observed: XChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD tags authenticate every section (outer HCX4 envelope, main section, profile sections, HPR1 inner layer, sidecars). The n19 content key folds the AAD through the n19 HMAC-prestate SHA-256 states (0xf1 prefix + certificate SHA-256). All tags verified by the harness against real samples.

limitations: No Android Gradle/NDK build was possible in this VM (no Android SDK/NDK installed); verification is a host-side build of the exact production C++ sources. On-device behaviour is NOT verified.

The 1 real password-protected n19 sample was not positively opened in this session (correct password not provided); the protected branch is positively verified only on synthetic fixtures built with the reference codec (same Argon2id params as the real file: a1/l=2/m=67108864).

The approved reader script hc942_banner.py composes the protected n19 key DIFFERENTLY from the cloud codec (see ANALYSIS.md section 4): the port follows the cloud codec (fold-plus-password-before-content-HKDF-v14), as instructed. A real protected 942 open is the only arbiter between the two compositions.

The V4 protections map has 24 keys (a-x), not 25: the task brief said 25, but the Python V4_PROTECTION_KEY_MAP and the C++ array both count 24. An earlier draft of the C++ array declared size 25 with 24 initializers, leaving a null pair that segfaulted on unknown keys; fixed to 24 and covered by a synthetic unknown-key case.
n16/n17/n18/b=9 remain unsupported by design (closed offline by proof).
